Name: MIMICRY_ESTABLISHMENT_TEX_PARAM_ST_DLC02
Description: Mimic's Veil disguise restrictions per part of the Realm of Shadow (m61), from the second map info texture's red channel (row ID 0–255 = channel value). Each row says which of the three disguise slots are blocked there; a blocked slot gives the player the matching GameSystemCommonParam block-transform SpEffect, and leaving the area (or any non-m61 map) removes it. Rows can split the area into a low and a high part by the player's height (Separate by High and Low Altitudes). No row: no slot blocked. The game ignores this param unless its data version is 3 or higher (retail: 3).

Fields.Name: High / Low Altitude Boundary Height
Fields.Description: Height in whole metres that splits the area when Separate by High and Low Altitudes is on. The player's height is their vertical position in the Realm of Shadow map's own coordinates: above this value the High Altitude flags apply, at or below it the Low Altitude flags. Can be negative (retail -200 to 530 on split rows).

Fields.Name: Separate by High and Low Altitudes
Fields.Description: On (non-zero): the row uses its Low Altitude and High Altitude block flags, picked by the player's height against High / Low Altitude Boundary Height, and its plain Block Disguise Slot flags are ignored. Off: the plain flags apply and the Low/High flags are ignored.

Fields.Name: Block Disguise Slot 0
Fields.Description: On: while the player is in this area, they have GameSystemCommonParam Block Chameleon Transform: Type 0 SpEffect (retail 20004270), which stops Mimic's Veil picking disguise slot 0 (unless all three slots are blocked); off removes it. 0 or -1 SpEffect ID: nothing happens. A per-slot state set by the game can replace this flag. Used only while Separate by High and Low Altitudes is off.

Fields.Name: Block Disguise Slot 1
Fields.Description: On: while the player is in this area, they have GameSystemCommonParam Block Chameleon Transform: Type 1 SpEffect (retail 20004271), which stops Mimic's Veil picking disguise slot 1 (unless all three slots are blocked); off removes it. 0 or -1 SpEffect ID: nothing happens. A per-slot state set by the game can replace this flag. Used only while Separate by High and Low Altitudes is off.
